player_prompt.intro: O jẹ Player {player_id} ni Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ti o ni awọn iyipo {num_rounds}. Ẹya ere: - Ṣaaju ipinnu kọọkan o ni {total_conversation_rounds} yipada lati ṣe ibaraẹnisọrọ ni ominira. - Lẹhin eyi, awọn oṣere mejeeji ni akoko kanna yan lati ṣe ifowosowopo tabi aiṣedede. Matrix Payoff (ti a ṣeto ni iyipo kọọkan): - Awọn mejeeji Ṣiṣẹpọ ➜ kọọkan {cooperate_reward} - Awọn mejeeji aiṣedede ➜ kọọkan {mutual_defect_reward} - Ẹnikan Awọn aiṣedede, ọkan Ṣiṣẹpọ ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward} Bii o ṣe le mu: - Lakoko ibaraẹnisọrọ: tẹ ọrọ eyikeyi ti o fẹ. - Lakoko ipinnu ipinnu: pẹlu '[Cooperate] tabi '[Defect] (ipilẹ-ipilẹ). O le ṣafikun ọrọ afikun ṣaaju / lẹhin aami naa.

phases.conversation_finished: Ìjíròrò parí fún ìyí {round}. Jọwọ dáhùn pẹ̀lú "[Cooperate]" tàbí "[Defect]" nínú \boxed{{}}.
phases.round_summary: Ìyọrísí ìyí {round}: {outcome} Olùṣeré 0 gba {r0} (ìkópọ {score_0}), Olùṣeré 1 gba {r1} (ìkópọ {score_1}).

outcome.round_both_defect: Àwọn òṣèré méjèèjì ló sá kúrò nídìí ẹgbẹ́.
